interfaces.name: Uniswap
interfaces.description: Uniswap is a decentralized exchange protocol where tokens are swapped against automated market maker (AMM) liquidity pools instead of an order book. Uniswap Labs runs the official web app, which routes trades across Uniswap v2, v3 and v4 pools on Ethereum and many layer-2 and EVM networks; liquidity providers earn swap fees and the protocol is governed by UNI holders.
interfaces.description_zh: Uniswap 是一个去中心化交易所协议，用户通过自动做市商（AMM）流动性池而非订单簿兑换代币。Uniswap Labs 运营官方网页应用，可在以太坊及众多二层网络和 EVM 网络上的 Uniswap v2、v3、v4 池之间路由交易；流动性提供者赚取交易手续费，协议由 UNI 持有者治理。
interfaces.repo_status: open (release mirror, dev in private repo)

geo_site.method: Code has no site-level geo-block. 2025 reports said the whole of Ukraine was blocked through 'third-party providers'

geo_feature.scope: RWA tokens, LP, migration, Toucan auctions: region gate GatedFeature.ISSUER_SPECIFIC_RWA plus per-token restriction reasons from compliance v2 (server decides by IP)

screening.provider: own compliance v2 API (entry-gateway.backend-prod.api.uniswap.org); TRM Labs historically (2022)
screening.fail_note: an unauthenticated session also counts as not-blocked

interfaces.notes: Screening and the RWA gate are calls to the Uniswap entry gateway. Routing (Trading API) goes through the same gateway and needs an API key.

interfaces.name: 1inch
interfaces.description: 1inch is a DEX aggregator that splits each swap across many liquidity sources to get a better price, with an intent-based Fusion mode in which resolvers fill orders without the user paying gas. It also offers limit orders, cross-chain swaps and its own wallet; 1INCH is the governance token.
interfaces.description_zh: 1inch 是一个 DEX 聚合器，会把每笔兑换拆分到多个流动性来源以获得更好的价格，并提供基于意图的 Fusion 模式，由解析者（resolver）成交订单、用户无需支付 gas。它还提供限价单、跨链兑换和自有钱包；1INCH 是治理代币。

geo_site.method: 2022: US geo-block, since lifted (FAQ now says the US is available)

screening.provider: TRM Labs (help center); ToS also names BlockAid, Web3 Antivirus, MetaMask, Innerworks

interfaces.notes: Closed. The 1inch API is public but needs a key; screening happens on 1inch's side. URL note: app.1inch.io -> 302.

interfaces.name: Aave
interfaces.description: Aave is one of the largest decentralized lending protocols. Users supply assets to earn interest and borrow against over-collateralized positions in pools on Ethereum and many layer-2 and EVM networks; Aave also issues the GHO stablecoin, and AAVE holders govern the protocol.
interfaces.description_zh: Aave 是最大的去中心化借贷协议之一。用户在以太坊及众多二层网络和 EVM 网络上的资金池中存入资产赚取利息，并以超额抵押的方式借款；Aave 还发行 GHO 稳定币，AAVE 持有者治理协议。

geo_site.method: ToS: region-based blocking; none in code (presumably edge)

screening.fail_note: status=error -> overlay; skipped in read-only mode

tos.restricted: 18: BY, CI, Crimea, CU, DPR, IR, IQ, Kherson, LR, LY, LPR, MM, KP, RU, SD, SY, VE, Zaporizhzhia

interfaces.notes: Fail-closed: without a working /api/preflight-compliance route the `AddressBlocked` wrapper in pages/_app.page.tsx locks out every user, IPFS builds included.

interfaces.name: Lido
interfaces.description: Lido is the largest liquid-staking protocol on Ethereum. Users stake ETH and receive stETH, a token that accrues staking rewards while remaining usable across DeFi; the validators are run by a curated set of node operators.
interfaces.description_zh: Lido 是以太坊上最大的流动性质押协议。用户质押 ETH 并获得 stETH，该代币会累积质押奖励，同时可以在 DeFi 中继续使用；验证者由一组经过筛选的节点运营商运行。

geo_feature.scope: /api/geo (cf-ipcountry): full|limited; remote config geo.limited=[US] -> Earn vaults; Tor/unknown -> limited

tos.restricted: Crimea, CU, DPR, IR, LPR, KP, SY + sanctioned; US/UK: Earn only

interfaces.notes: The IPFS build lets you control the API base paths. Stake/Withdraw are not geo-gated.

interfaces.name: Polymarket
interfaces.description: Polymarket is a prediction market where users buy and sell shares on the outcomes of real-world events. Trades are matched in an off-chain order book and settled in USDC on Polygon, with outcomes resolved through UMA's optimistic oracle.
interfaces.description_zh: Polymarket 是一个预测市场，用户买卖关于现实世界事件结果的份额。交易在链下订单簿中撮合，并以 USDC 在 Polygon 上结算，结果通过 UMA 的乐观预言机裁定。

geo_site.method: polymarket.com/api/geoblock decides by IP: in blocked countries and regions markets stay viewable but trading is refused; close-only countries can only close positions. Lists from the help center (revision of 2026-08-14)

vpn.note: Help center: using a VPN to bypass the restrictions violates the Terms (section 2.1.4); no detection mechanism documented

interfaces.notes: The CLOB API itself is geo-blocked for the main tiers, not only the website.
live: /api/geoblock (US) -> {blocked: true, country: US, region: OH}; overlay 'Trading is blocked in the United States'

interfaces.name: Centrifuge
interfaces.description: Centrifuge is a platform for tokenizing real-world assets such as Treasury funds, private credit and structured credit. Asset managers issue pool tokens on Ethereum and other networks; investors onboard with each manager (KYC and jurisdiction checks), and only approved wallets on a pool's on-chain memberlist can invest or hold the tokens.
interfaces.description_zh: Centrifuge 是一个将现实世界资产（如国债基金、私人信贷和结构化信贷）代币化的平台。资产管理人在以太坊等网络上发行资金池代币；投资者需分别通过各管理人的开户流程（KYC 和司法管辖区检查），只有列入资金池链上成员名单的钱包才能投资或持有代币。
interfaces.chains: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Plume
interfaces.repo_status: open (monorepo for Centrifuge frontends; last push 2025-10-01, may lag the current app)

geo_feature.scope: Per pool: managers apply KYC/AML and jurisdiction screening and the app restricts access where a pool requires it; flagship funds are non-US offerings. Country lists are set per pool and not published centrally.

kyc.scope: Per pool: KYC/AML with the asset manager, then the wallet is added to the pool's on-chain memberlist (separately on each network) before it can invest or hold tokens.

tos.us_scope: set per pool; flagship funds are non-US offerings
tos.restricted: Services may be unavailable in some jurisdictions or limited to sophisticated, accredited or qualified investors

interfaces.notes: The frontend is open source (centrifuge/apps); investing requires the manager's approval on the pool's on-chain memberlist.

interfaces.name: Hyperliquid
interfaces.description: Hyperliquid is a layer-1 blockchain with a fully on-chain order book for perpetual futures and spot trading, plus the HyperEVM smart-contract environment; HYPE is its native token.
interfaces.description_zh: Hyperliquid 是一条一层区块链，内置完全链上的永续合约与现货订单簿，并提供 HyperEVM 智能合约环境；HYPE 是其原生代币。

geo_site.method: IP check (US, Ontario, sanctioned jurisdictions — the latter not enumerated); info API has legalCheck {user} -> restrictions/ipAllowed

interfaces.notes: The check is the legalCheck call of the info API; builder-code frontends (Sushi and others) call it themselves. The trading API does not refuse orders on that basis.

interfaces.name: Superstate
interfaces.description: Superstate issues tokenized funds and shares on Ethereum: USTB (a short-duration US Treasury fund) and USCC (a crypto basis fund) for qualified investors, plus Opening Bell tokenized public equities. Holding the tokens requires Superstate onboarding and an allowlisted wallet.
interfaces.description_zh: Superstate 在以太坊上发行代币化基金和股份：面向合格投资者的 USTB（短期美国国债基金）和 USCC（加密基差基金），以及 Opening Bell 代币化公开股票。持有这些代币需要完成 Superstate 开户并使用白名单钱包。

geo_feature.scope: Funds (USTB, USCC): qualified purchasers in supported countries only (at least $5m investable assets for individuals, $25m for institutions). Tokenized equities: all investors in supported jurisdictions. Access is an allowlist of supported countries rather than a list of banned ones.

kyc.scope: Onboarding with KYC (via Parallel Markets), then wallet allowlisting; USTB transfers to non-allowlisted addresses revert on-chain.

tos.us_scope: USTB/USCC: US accredited investors / qualified purchasers
tos.restricted: Only investors in supported countries (allowlist of roughly 22-29 countries, updated regularly)

interfaces.notes: Closed frontend. USTB transfers to non-allowlisted addresses revert at the contract level.
